name: CreateMailFolder
description: Creates a new folder in a specified Microsoft 365 mailbox using the Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: Microsoft 365 Credentials
fields.description: The Microsoft 365 credentials used to authenticate and access mailbox data through the Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox where the folder will be created. If provided, it targets a shared or delegated mailbox. If left empty, the request will fail.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.label: Folder Name
fields.description: The name to assign to the newly created folder.

fields.name: IsHidden
fields.label: Visibility
fields.description: Indicates whether the folder should be hidden from the mailbox view. Set to 'true' to hide, or 'false' to make it visible.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Creation Result
fields.description: The result of the folder creation, including the folder ID and any associated error messages.
